page.content:
2010–18 Cartoon Network series in the Land of Ooo.

How Adventure Time (series) connects

  • Topic: Adventure Time — The 2010 series is the core Adventure Time work.
  • Character: Finn the Human — The series is Finn's coming-of-age in Ooo.
  • Creator: Pendleton Ward — Ward created and early-showran the Adventure Time series.
  • Character: Jake the Dog — Jake is Finn's brother through the original series.
  • Location: Land of Ooo — The original series is set in the Land of Ooo.
  • Character: Princess Bubblegum — Princess Bubblegum is a central sovereign of the series.
  • Character: The Lich — The Lich is the series' oldest extinction threat.
  • Series: Fionna and Cake — Fionna and Cake follows years after the original series.

What is Adventure Time (series)?

The original series follows Finn and Jake from short dungeon crawls into the long myths of Bubblegum, Marceline, Simon, the Lich, and the Mushroom War.

Key threads lead to Adventure Time, Finn the Human, Pendleton Ward, Jake the Dog, Land of Ooo and Princess Bubblegum.
